SecretChanged.show_if: =secret.id == event.secret_id && mine(secret.created_by) && entry.target == event.secret_id && !entry.redacted && !mine(entry.account) && (entry.action == 'secret_updated' || entry.action == 'secret_trashed' || entry.action == 'secret_restored')

fields.summary: =entry.action == 'secret_trashed' ? 'Moved it to the trash' : entry.action == 'secret_restored' ? 'Restored it from the trash' : 'Edited it'

SecretChanged.title: =entry.action == 'secret_trashed' ? 'Trashed your ' + secret.kind : entry.action == 'secret_restored' ? 'Restored your ' + secret.kind : 'Changed your ' + secret.kind

fields.what: =entry.action == 'member_removed' ? 'You were removed from a vault' : 'Your vault role changed'
fields.state: =entry.action == 'member_removed' ? 'You no longer have access to ' + info.name : 'You are now ' + info.my_role + ' in ' + info.name
